title: feat(metadata-protocol)!: thread the installed-manifest lookup through every pair site; the ensure door creates no pair for a kernel package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoF7zm6g9Ti1PzWyHemzLqez)_

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — both arms. Narrowing: `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/ensure-customization` answers a kernel base (scope `system` / `cloud`) with `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, where it created `<id>.custom`; `POST /api/v1/automation/:name/clone` of a kernel-shipped flow with no `package` named answers that `409` where it answered `200` with the copy in `<id>.custom`; the exported pair helpers take the installed-manifest lookup as a required argument. Widening: five new exports, `installedManifestsOf`, `InstalledManifestLookup`, `AppLookupManifest` and `InstalledPackageSource` (`@objectstack/metadata-core`) and `kernelPackageScope` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`), and a copy of a kernel-shipped permission set with no `package` named is saved environment-wide under the new notice code `PERMISSION_SET_CLONE_ENVIRONMENT_WIDE_KERNEL_SOURCE`, where it landed in `<kernel id>.custom`.
Metadata-protocol: none

Refs #29594
Ruling-ref: 6691022506
Ruling-ref: 6691217245

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：①所有「这个包的定制包是谁」的问题（`pairOf` / `isPairOf` / `isServedOverrideRowOf` / 写闸 / flow 优先级 等 23 处、14 个文件，连同 cli 与 cloud-connection 的调用方）都改为携带「已安装清单查询」，`appOf` 仍是恒等，行为不变；②ensure 门对内核包（scope `system` / `cloud`）返回 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`，不再创建 `<id>.custom`。
- **为什么改**：按裁定 6691022506（定制单位 = App）与 6691217245（本版本内核对象一律不可定制，ensure 门给可读的拒绝而非 422）。查询先穿好，PR 3 才能只改 `appOf` 一处把模块解析到它的 App。
- **风险与回滚**：已在某些部署上由旧门建好的内核配对包继续安装、继续被读取、继续可写，只拒绝 ensure 调用；内核条目的无包写入与指名内核包的写入仍按 D11 拒绝（403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE），提示语改为「本版本内核对象不可定制」，不再点名配对包；克隆平台权限集（如 member_default）且未指定包时，副本改存为环境级（维护者已选 A，2026-11-07T01:01Z）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-customization-package.ts`（内核判定）、`packages/metadata-core/src/customization-pair-lookup.ts`（查询入口）、`packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-override-effective-read.test.ts` 末尾两条钉子。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local src/domains/packages-ensure-customization.test.ts`（内核 409、旧配对包保留）；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local src/protocol-custom-override-effective-read.test.ts`（旧内核配对包的覆盖继续生效；两道关闭对内核条目仍拒绝且不点名配对包）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。PR 3（`appOf` 翻转、旧配对包容忍、ensure 门回答 App 配对包、HotCRM 演练）在本 PR 合并且 ADR-0146 修订 #31027 合并后开工。

## What changes

### 1. The installed-manifest lookup, threaded through every pair site (behaviour unchanged)

`pairOf(base) = customizationPackageId(appOf(base))` landed in #31026 with `appOf` the identity. Resolving a module to its App (ADR-0146 amendment, merge question 11, #31027) needs the registry's installed manifests (`type` / `dependencies` / `namespace` / `scope`) at **every** site that asks "which pair customizes this package?". If only the ensure door resolved the App, the override gate and the served-override read (still identity) would refuse or hide the very override written into the App pair. So this PR threads the lookup everywhere first, with `appOf` still the identity, and PR 3 becomes a one-place flip.

- `@objectstack/metadata-core`: `InstalledManifestLookup`, `installedManifestsOf(registry)`; `appOf`, `pairOf`, `isPairOf` take the lookup (required, so the compiler names every site that has not passed it).
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: `installedManifestsOfEngine(engine)`; `isServedOverrideRowOf(row, base, installed)`, `OverrideWriteClosure.installed`, the overlay merge, the lock state, the layered/list reads, the per-package layer, the stored-flow slot, the served-overrides census, the package-less migration census, the packaged-base refusal and the write gates. Hosts that read the engine gain the `engine` getter (the codebase's `readEngine` pattern).
- Callers outside it: `objectql` (plugin, registry uninstall refusal), `runtime` (`customizeInPairRemedy`, the per-package customizations read), `service-automation` (flow precedence, with the objectql registry), `service-datasource`, `cli` (offline override declarations: the walked manifests), `cloud-connection` (install-local: the delivered manifests over the registry's).
- Proof nothing moves: `customization-pair-lookup.test.ts` asks every row twice, with nothing installed and with every row installed (the module declaring its App the way HotCRM's modules do), and gets the old derivation; every existing suite of the touched packages is green with the lookup passed.
- Review nit 3 of #31026: `os validate`'s customization-namespace advisory skips a pair through `isCustomizationPackage`. Edge: an id ending in `.custom` that no base derives (`a.custom.custom`, bare `.custom`, `A.custom`) was skipped before, because `customizationPackageId` answers `base_is_customization_package` for it, and is now judged like any package, because `isCustomizationPackage` answers `false` (measured on the head's spec build).

### 2. The kernel verdict on the ensure door (narrowing)

| Call | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| ensure a kernel base (scope `system` / `cloud`), no pair yet | `201`, creates `<id>.custom` | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, nothing created or written |
| ensure a kernel base whose pair an earlier version created | `200`, `created: false` | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`; the pair stays installed and readable |
| every read of a kernel item's name with a declared override in that legacy pair | the override is served | unchanged |
| a save into that legacy pair declaring the override | admitted | unchanged (the write gate never asks the ensure door) |
| package-less save onto an item a kernel package ships (overlay types) | `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, naming the pair | `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, the sentence says kernel objects are not customizable in this version and names no pair |
| save naming the kernel package onto an item it ships | `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, naming the pair | `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, the same sentence, no pair named |
| clone a kernel-shipped permission set, no `package` | `200`, copy in `<kernel id>.custom` (created) | `200`, copy environment-wide, code `PERMISSION_SET_CLONE_ENVIRONMENT_WIDE_KERNEL_SOURCE` |
| clone a kernel-shipped flow, no `package` | `200`, copy in `<kernel id>.custom` | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, the ensure door's sentence |
| any non-kernel base | — | unchanged |

**The code.** `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` is the door's existing family for "the base's state rules the pair out" (a writable base, no namespace, a namespace with no pair namespace, a non-SemVer version, a malformed existing pair), every one of which answers `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` in `packages-ensure-customization.test.ts`. `403` would misread as an authority problem (even the platform operator is refused), and `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` names another condition. No ledger code and no `packages/spec` edit.

**Where.** First in `customizationPairEnsureRefusal`, the one reading of the door's registry-decidable refusals, and the two overlay closes keep their place: `overlayPairFixOf` asks the door's other judgements with the kernel verdict left out (`judgeKernel: false`) and marks a kernel base's fix with its `kernelScope`, so the package-less close and the close of a write naming the base stay shut on a kernel item exactly where they were, with a sentence that names no pair (seat ruling on review should-fix 2; ruling record 6691217245; #31027 Q10 is unmerged).

**The "new similar" doors (found by the dogfood battery).** The permission-set clone door landed a copy of a kernel-shipped set (`member_default`, shipped by `com.objectstack.plugin-security`, scope `system`) in the source package's pair through the ensure door, so the verdict refused the commonest lock-and-clone path. A clone is a new item, not a customization of the kernel item, so with no `package` named the copy is now saved environment-wide, exactly as a copy of an environment-authored set is, with its own notice and code (`PERMISSION_SET_CLONE_ENVIRONMENT_WIDE_KERNEL_SOURCE`; a Console that does not know the code shows the English sentence, as it does for any unknown code). A named `package` still lands there. The kernel predicate is one spelling, `kernelPackageScope` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`), read by the door and the clone door. The flow clone door has no environment-wide landing (an unpackaged flow already needs `package`), so a kernel-shipped flow gets the ensure door's 409 sentence. This landing is option A of a decision card put to the maintainer; B (refuse, naming `package`) and C (a kernel pair for clones only) are the alternatives.

**Test fixtures.** `packages-ensure-customization.test.ts` and `automation-flow-clone-custom-package.test.ts` modelled "an installed app" as `scope: 'system'`, which is the kernel's scope (manifest schema: `system` = cross-project shared identity, `cloud` = control plane). They now hold the base as code, the way an installed app's packages are held (HotCRM 6961ab1 declares no scope).

## Blast radius (measured on `origin/main` 3fe5f2a0)

23 `pairOf` / `isPairOf` sites in 14 files; `isServedOverrideRowOf` 17 non-test callers; `judgeOverrideWrite` 4 (incl. `cli` offline and `cloud-connection` install-local). This PR: 31 source files (+471 / −156), 16 test files (+342 / −123), one changeset; 48 files, +842 / −279 in all.

## PR 2 / PR 3 split

- **PR 2 (this):** the lookup through every site, `appOf` the identity; the kernel verdict.
- **PR 3 (after this lands and #31027 merges):** `appOf` resolves App membership from the lookup (Q11); legacy per-package pairs stay served (Q12: `isPairOf` accepts the App pair or an installed legacy `<base>.custom`); the ensure door answers the App pair with `basePackageId` = the App id (the spec describe "`packageId`: `<basePackageId>.custom`" stays true); the HotCRM rehearsal.

Findings kept for PR 3: the package-less migration's incomplete-declarations census parses pair→base (`customizationBasePackageId`) and misses module overrides under the App unit; its census still lists a kernel item's package-less row as `movable` and the apply step fails it with the kernel sentence (a disposition for it is a contract question); the dogfood helper `customization-pair.ts` and six `ui/packages/app-shell` call sites derive `<base>.custom` client-side; a `customizable` flag on the package list row would need a spec sub-card. A package-less row on a kernel item stored before the D11 close stays served, but nothing can move it now: its package-less delete is closed, and the ceremony's ensure step refuses the kernel base. Its disposition belongs with the census question already listed.

## Verification

Head `b94d1ac68d151d99ad908992ad25f65bf2413a6d`, which merges today's `origin/main` 022b4e7e (merge commit 20c8cd6e, no conflicts; no rebase). Exit codes landed on disk before reading.

| Run | Result |
|:--|:--|
| `pnpm typecheck` in metadata-protocol, objectql, runtime, service-automation (head) | exit 0 each |
| `pnpm test` on the head: metadata-protocol / objectql / runtime / service-automation / metadata-core / lint | exit 0 each: 22512 (+26 skipped) / 11360 / 8876 (+19 skipped) / 3431 / 962 / 8331 passed |
| `pnpm test` on `1340933c` for the packages this round did not touch: service-datasource / cloud-connection / cli | exit 0 each: 1279 / 931 / 7415 (+9) passed |
| dogfood battery on `021a8a3d` (no dogfood pin moved this round) | exit 0: 428 files passed, 3 skipped; 3562 tests passed |
| eslint `--no-inline-config` on every `.ts` file this round changed | exit 0 |
| `dispatch-gates --commands` on the head (102 families: the 101 of the last round plus `check:overlay-whitelist-table`, which the lifecycle docs edit adds), each run with `</dev/null` | 102 exit 0 on the first pass; reconciled with `--ran`: 102 derived, 102 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN |

Gate notes: the three first-pass non-zeros of the earlier round (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:test-source-alias`) all exit 0 on this head with no further change.

**Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven by blob hash == HEAD and an empty `git status --porcelain`):

- the kernel check in `customizationPairEnsureRefusal` disabled (`ablation-dist-preflight` confirmed the mutation in `metadata-protocol/dist`): red — the three runtime door pins (system, cloud, the legacy kernel pair) and the objectql pin of the legacy pair served after a refused ensure;
- the kernel landing in `resolveDefaultCloneLanding` disabled: red — `[#29594] a set a kernel package ships copies environment-wide`;
- the kernel close in `overlayPairFixOf` disabled (`judgeKernel: false` removed, metadata-protocol dist rebuilt and checked): red, `the closes keep refusing a kernel item's save, naming no pair` (the save was admitted);
- `restoreFlowRegistration` on a refused landing in `registerAndSaveFlow` disabled: red, both `[#29594] a kernel-shipped flow` cases (the engine held the copy).

Both restored with `git checkout`, tree clean, suites re-run green.

The lookup threading needs no ablation: it changes no answer, which every existing suite of the nine packages confirms, and `customization-pair-lookup.test.ts` pins that both lookups (nothing installed, every row installed) give the old derivation.

## Acceptance notes

- The harness's assignee/reviewer step is skipped: this PR goes through the relay as a draft, and review is requested by the seat.
- No `packages/spec`, `ui/` or `skills/` edit; no ADR edit.
- 51 files: 31 source files, 16 test files, 3 docs pages (`content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` added), 1 changeset.
